fields.label: Your story
fields.sample:
The morning after the wedding, we shut our suitcases and folded a map in half: half sea, half city. In Kaş we swam to the coves in the mornings and befriended street cats in the evenings. In Florence, getting lost was allowed; in Portofino, it felt like walking inside a postcard.
Now we’re home, and the suitcases still aren’t fully unpacked. But the best memory is that we set off on this journey with your prayers.

fields.label: Thank-you message
fields.sample:
Thank you endlessly for being with us on this journey, for sharing our joy and for making this day unforgettable for us.
We’re so glad to have you; here’s to meeting again on many more happy days.

elements.name: İmza
elements.text: Our reporter files from the passenger seat

elements.name: Haber metni
elements.text:
The morn­ing after the wed­ding, before the con­fet­ti had even been picked out of their hair, the couple was spot­ted at the air­port. They were car­ry­ing two suit­cas­es, a map and a half-eaten box of wed­ding cake. Ac­cord­ing to eye­wit­ness­es, the bride made the of­fi­cer smile at pass­port con­trol: “My sur­name has changed, but my heart is the same.”
Details of the route were kept secret for a long time. Ac­cord­ing to in­for­ma­tion leaked from behind the scenes, the couple will first head south to turquoise coves, then get lost in the cob­ble­stone streets of Italy and end the jour­ney in a small harbor town. We have learned that even the only guide­book they packed was bought at a bookstore.
In our brief in­ter­view at the air­port, asked why the suit­cas­es were so heavy, the groom replied, “Half is the bride’s shoes; the other half is empty for the gifts we’ll bring back.” The bride, mean­while, kept the route’s most an­tic­i­pat­ed stop a secret and simply smiled. The couple was re­port­ed­ly con­grat­u­lat­ed in the cabin an­nounce­ment, with pas­sen­gers join­ing in with applause.
According to the latest update our re­porter filed from the pas­sen­ger seat, skies are clear, the wind is light and hap­pi­ness is com­plete. Every stop of the jour­ney, the log­book and what came out of the suit­case are on the inside pages.

elements.text: Ten days, four stops on the map

elements.name: İlan metni
elements.text: Lost on the beach in Kaş, day three: a pair of sunglasses. Brown frames, a bit scratched, much loved. Finder, please return; reward is an ice cream from Florence and many thanks.

elements.name: Bölüm Rota · On günde dört durak
elements.text: Route · Four stops in ten days

elements.name: Harita notu
elements.text: Map not to scale; happiness can’t be measured. Dashed line: our route · Numbers: stops.

elements.name: Durak yazısı İstanbul
elements.text: We set off by ferry. We tossed simit to the seag­ulls, took one last look at the city and made a pact: a post­card from every stop. One suit­case was heavy, the other empty; coming home, both would be stuffed.

elements.name: Konaklama İstanbul
elements.text: Stayed at: home, the single couch one last time

elements.name: En güzel an İstanbul
elements.text: Best moment: the first “wifey” on the ferry

elements.name: Durak yazısı Kaş
elements.text: Morn­ings we hopped from cove to cove by boat; evenings we ate fish at the harbor. We forgot the sun­screen; lesson learned, noses peeled. On a night swim we tried count­ing the stars and gave up at five.

elements.name: Konaklama Kaş
elements.text: Stayed at: a stone house facing the sea

elements.name: Durak yazısı Floransa
elements.text: We folded the map into a bag and chose to get lost. Ev­ery­one we asked sent us a dif­fer­ent way; that’s how we found the loveli­est square. The three-gelatos-a-day rule was never broken.

elements.name: Konaklama Floransa
elements.text: Stayed at: a guesthouse facing the bridge

elements.name: En güzel an Floransa
elements.text: Best moment: sunset on the bridge

elements.name: Durak yazısı Portofino
elements.text: At the last stop, we took off our watch­es. We sat by the harbor writ­ing post­cards; one will reach each of you. On our farewell evening, the col­or­ful houses lit up one by one.

elements.name: Konaklama Portofino
elements.text: Stayed at: a hotel facing the harbor

elements.name: Öneri
elements.text: It never goes back the way it was anyway; keep it open and enjoy get­ting lost.

elements.name: Öneri
elements.text: One at every stop. Back home, they’ll make the loveli­est scrap­book.

elements.name: Öneri
elements.text: Half full going, crammed coming back: gifts, sand and mem­o­ries take up room.

elements.name: Öneri
elements.text: On a hon­ey­moon, time is mea­sured only in sun­sets; the rest is detail.

elements.name: Bölüm Seyahat günlüğü · Gün gün balayı
Spot
elements.text: Four cities, ten days and a typewriter: all the trip’s notes, telegrams and what came out of the suitcase.

elements.name: Defter 1
elements.text:
Day 1 — Simit on the ferry, coffee in Galata. Heavy suitcase, light heart.
Day 2 — Flight delayed. Our first airport coffee as “husband and wife.”
Day 3 — Kaş. The sea is so blue the camera got confused.
Day 4 — Cove-hopping by boat. Sunscreen forgotten, lesson learned.
Day 5 — Harbor, fish, sunset. Early start tomorrow: the suitcase won’t close.

elements.name: Defter 2
elements.text:
Day 6 — Florence. We asked for directions, got the wrong ones and found the most beautiful square.
Day 7 — Three gelatos, two museums, endless stairs. Our legs are protesting.
Day 8 — By train to the coast. Out the window: olive trees, the sea, more sea.
Day 9 — Portofino. Colorful houses, little boats. Postcards written.
Day 10 — Home. The suitcase opened; out spilled sand and happiness.

elements.name: Günlük altyazısı
elements.text: Kaş at sunset: the honeymoon’s favorite hour.

elements.text: Next stop: our first anniversary. The route isn’t set yet; suggestions welcome, and the best one wins a postcard.

elements.name: Altyazı
elements.text: The best part of the journey: having all of you to hug when we get back.

elements.name: Spot
elements.text: The suitcases were opened: out came sand, postcards and a huge thank-you.

elements.name: Kartpostal notu
elements.text: You look lovely from here. The sea is blue, the coffee strong, and we’re happy. We miss you all so much; hugs when we’re back!

elements.name: Teşekkür notu
elements.text: Even while packing, you were on our minds. Thank you for everything, always; your gifts are on the way.

elements.name: Teşekkür notu
elements.text: You never let the dance floor rest at the wedding, or our phones on the honeymoon. See you at photo night.

elements.name: Teşekkür notu
elements.text: We boarded before the ink on your signatures was dry. Stay with us at every stop to come.

elements.name: Teşekkür notu
elements.text: Postcards are on the way. We saved one for those who couldn’t come, too, with love.

elements.name: İlan metni
elements.text: One used map. Won’t fold, but every corner is full of memories.

elements.name: İlan metni
elements.text: Volunteers to unpack the suitcases and sweep up the sand. Reward: gifts.

elements.name: İlan metni
elements.text: Get ready for honeymoon photo night: 2,000 shots, lots of tea, endless patience.
